items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 10 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Invoice date (document_date) is Wed 04.02.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (04.02.2026) is not counted, so the 10-calendar-day period starts 05.02.2026. Counting 10 days forward (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Sat 14.02.2026. This is a private-law (civil) payment obligation, so § 193 BGB applies: since the last day falls on a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next business day, Mon 16.02.2026.

warnings: The letter is a private company's invoice, not an authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the invoice date itself is the starting point.

The line "Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich" (partial payments possible by arrangement) is an offer, not a firm right — confirm any instalment plan with the sender in writing before relying on it.
